properties.description: Two layers. (A) CLASS, in crates/reflow2-mcp/src/service/view.rs unit tests: every_served_tool_can_be_aimed_at_one_member reads the whole served list (200 tools) and holds view::aim to five answers for each tool, read or write, with arguments the schema accepts or refuses: `member: A` aims at A; an id "A:…" aims at A; `member` naming the hub runs on the hub alone; `member` naming no design of the view is refused; `member` A beside an id of B is refused. no_served_tool_takes_an_argument_named_member keeps `member` the view's own. a_whole_value_or_a_refusals_word_naming_a_held_id_is_prefixed pins the value and text prefix rules. member_is_taken_out_of_the_arguments_and_must_be_a_graph_id. (B) THE REAL BINARY, on_disk program: a --registry-root server behind a trusted gateway serving hub H and members A and B. (1) tools/list naming the view declares `member` on every tool; with no view, or from a server with no trusted host, on none. (2) loop_status, reasoning_report, detect_gaps, describe_schema, find_tools, find_skills, get_skill, get_instructions and usage_report with `member: A` run on A alone (no by_design, view note naming A). describe_schema {tool} serves A's lesson. scan_nodes and search_design cover A only. claim_region and release_claim act on A's claims and not H's. `member: H` scans H alone. (3) reasoning_report on A's reductio (routed by claim, and aimed with no claim) and get_node on an inference: no id A holds comes back bare. An add_inference refusal names the passed premise as "A:req:nowhere", and a reasoning_report refusal names its claim the same way. (4) add_release {id: "A:rel:v1"} through H lands in A, and H holds neither spelling. (5) `member` naming no view design, beside B's id (nothing written in B), outside the readable set, with no view on the call, and on a server serving no view: each refused.
properties.findings: Failing first on main 4bcfddafb: all 5 registry tests failed. The listing declared `member` on no tool. `member` was refused as "not a parameter of this tool". add_release acted on the hub ("not served as a view"). reasoning_report through H gave 9 of A's ids bare: con:def-finite, con:def-prime, inf:absurd, inf:euclid, inf:theorem, req:contradiction, req:lemma-euclid, req:suppose-finite and req:theorem (assumes, conclusion, assumed_in …). The refusal case failed on the same bare-id cause. With the change (6c36442b5): 5 of 5 pass, the existing 10 hub-view tests stay green, 8 of 8 view unit tests pass, and all 200 toolsnaps match. Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019Xbw6PG9mXJiU2Sb421fnq
